items.name: Cloak of the Freed Fields
items.lore: Rowan green, with the Order's tree on it. Sewn in the grove for those who were there the day the fields were freed.

items.name: Rowan-Ward Charm
items.lore: A rowan twig bound in red thread. Fire won't come near it - or near you, much.

items.name: Ash-and-Berry Ring
items.lore: Wicker ash and a rowan berry, sealed in bronze. What burned, and what grew back.

items.name: Grove-Tender's Bracer
items.lore: Worn by the druids who plant the grove. It smells of earth and smoke.

items.name: Voice of the Azure's Torc
items.lore: Blue gold, the Voice's own. The Rowan quenched it in a holy well. It still glows, a little, when it's angry.

draughts: Meadowsweet from the freed fields, steeped by the Rowan. It heals.
Elderflower and spring water. For the mind more than the body.
Sharp, red and warming. The druids drink it before a long walk.
Wicker ash and honey: the Rowan swear by it for burns, and for everything else.
Everything the grove grows, in one bottle. Everything comes back a little faster.
